title.en: The bar magnet and magnetic field lines

heading.en: Break a magnet, get two magnets

hook.en: Snap a *bar magnet* in two and you do not get a lone north pole. You get two smaller magnets, each with its own north and south pole. Magnetic poles always come in pairs.
hook.kn: ದಂಡಕಾಂತವನ್ನು ಎರಡು ತುಂಡು ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಒಂಟಿ ಉತ್ತರ ಧ್ರುವ ಸಿಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ಉತ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಧ್ರುವ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಎರಡು ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಾಂತಗಳು ಸಿಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಕಾಂತೀಯ ಧ್ರುವಗಳು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಜೋಡಿಯಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Snap a bar magnet in two and you do not get a lone north pole. You get two smaller magnets, each with its own north and south pole. Magnetic poles always come in pairs. In this lesson: List the properties of magnetic field lines.
Treat a bar magnet as an equivalent solenoid and find its axial and equatorial fields.

body.en: *Magnetic field lines* form continuous closed loops: outside a magnet they run from N to S, and inside from S to N. The tangent at a point gives the direction of B; the density of lines gives its strength. Field lines never intersect. Unlike electric field lines, they do not start or end anywhere, because isolated magnetic poles (monopoles) are not known.
body.kn: ಕಾಂತೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಕುಣಿಕೆಗಳು. ಕಾಂತದ ಹೊರಗೆ N ಇಂದ S ಗೆ, ಒಳಗೆ S ಇಂದ N ಗೆ. ಅವು ಛೇದಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; ದಟ್ಟ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಪ್ರಬಲ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ.

points.en: Closed loops: N → S outside, S → N inside
Tangent gives the direction of B

narration.en: Magnetic field lines are closed loops. Outside a magnet they go from north to south, and inside from south to north. They never cross, and crowded lines mean a strong field.

say.en: Magnetic field lines are closed loops. Outside a magnet they go from north to south, and inside from south to north. They never cross, and crowded lines mean a strong field. Closed loops: N gives S outside, S gives N inside.

title.en: On the board: field of a bar magnet

narration.en: Field lines of a bar magnet leave the north pole, curve round outside, and enter the south pole. Inside the magnet they run from S back to N, so every magnetic field line is a closed loop. A bar magnet behaves just like a current-carrying solenoid with the same magnetic moment m. On the axis B = (μ₀/4π)·2m/r³; on the equatorial line it is half as large and opposite to m. Example: m = 0.4 A m² at 20 cm on the axis gives B = 10⁻⁷ × 0.8 / 0.008 = 10⁻⁵ tesla.

Field lines of a bar magnet leave the north pole, curve round outside, and enter the south pole. Inside the magnet they run from S back to N, so every magnetic field line is a closed loop. A bar magnet behaves just like a current-carrying solenoid with the same magnetic moment m. On the axis B equals (micro 0 over 4 pi) 2m/r cubed; on the equatorial line it is half as large and opposite to m. Example: m equals 0.4 A m squared at 20 centimetres on the axis gives B equals 10 to the power minus 7 times 0.8 divided by 0.008 equals 10 to the power minus 5 tesla.

title.en: Bar magnet as an equivalent solenoid

body.en: A *bar magnet* and a current-carrying solenoid of the same shape produce the same field pattern; both have a magnetic moment m directed from S to N. Far away the field is that of a dipole: on the axis $B = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi}\frac{2m}{r^3}$, on the equatorial line $B = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi}\frac{m}{r^3}$ (opposite to m). These match the electric dipole formulas with $1/4\pi\varepsilon_0 \to \mu_0/4\pi$ and p → m.
body.kn: ದಂಡಕಾಂತ ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ನಂತೆ ವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ (μ₀/4π)(2m/r³), ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ (μ₀/4π)(m/r³).

points.en: m points from S to N (unit A m² or J T⁻¹)

narration.en: A bar magnet behaves like a solenoid. Far away its field is a dipole field: on the axis it is mu nought by 4 pi times 2m by r cubed, and on the equator half of that.
narration.kn: ದಂಡಕಾಂತ ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ನಂತೆ ವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ (μ₀/4π)(2m/r³), ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ (μ₀/4π)(m/r³).

say.en: A bar magnet behaves like a solenoid. Far away its field is a dipole field: on the axis it is mu nought by 4 pi times 2 metres by r cubed, and on the equator half of that. m points from S to N (unit A m squared or J T to the power minus 1).
say.kn: ದಂಡಕಾಂತ ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ನಂತೆ ವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ (micro 0 over 4 pi)(2m/r cubed), ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ (micro 0 over 4 pi)(m over r cubed).

say.en: Axial: (micro 0 over 4 pi) 2m/r cubed.
Equatorial: (micro 0 over 4 pi) m over r cubed.

caption.en: Field lines leave the north pole, curve round and enter the south pole; they crowd together near the poles, where the field is strongest. Try this: Move the compass around the magnet and draw the needle direction at each place; join them into field lines.

aim.en: To find which materials are magnetic, to show that like poles repel and unlike poles attract, and to see the pattern of the magnetic field around a bar magnet. Try this: Sprinkle iron filings around the bar magnet and then trace the field with a compass: join the needle directions into field lines and see them crowd together near the poles, where B is strongest.
aim.kn: ಯಾವ ವಸ್ತುಗಳು ಕಾಂತೀಯ ಎಂದು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುವುದು, ಸಜಾತೀಯ ಧ್ರುವಗಳು ವಿಕರ್ಷಿಸಿ ವಿಜಾತೀಯ ಧ್ರುವಗಳು ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುವುದು, ದಂಡಕಾಂತದ ಸುತ್ತಲಿನ ಕಾಂತಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ಮಾದರಿ ನೋಡುವುದು. ಇದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ: ದಂಡಕಾಂತದ ಸುತ್ತ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ಪುಡಿ ಚೆಲ್ಲಿ, ನಂತರ ದಿಕ್ಸೂಚಿಯಿಂದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ: ಸೂಜಿಯ ದಿಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರರೇಖೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಿರಿ; B ಅತಿ ಪ್ರಬಲವಾಗಿರುವ ಧ್ರುವಗಳ ಬಳಿ ಅವು ದಟ್ಟವಾಗುವುದನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ.

problem.en: A short bar magnet has m = 0.4 A m². Find the field 20 cm from its centre (a) on its axis and (b) on its equatorial line.

steps.en: (b) Half of the axial value: 5 × 10⁻⁶ T.

answer.en: 1 × 10⁻⁵ T on the axis; 5 × 10⁻⁶ T on the equator

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A short bar magnet has m = 0.4 A m². Find the field 20 cm from its centre (a) on its axis and (b) on its equatorial line.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A short bar magnet has m equals 0.4 A m squared. Find the field 20 centimetres from its centre a on its axis and b on its equatorial line.
a B equals (micro 0 over 4 pi)(2m/r cubed) equals 10 to the power minus 7 times 2 times 0.4 over 0.2 cubed.
= 8 times 10 to the power minus 8 over 8 times 10 to the power minus 3 equals 1 times 10 to the power minus 5 T.
b Half of the axial value: 5 times 10 to the power minus 6 T.
So the answer is 1 times 10 to the power minus 5 T on the axis; 5 times 10 to the power minus 6 T on the equator.

problem.en: A bar magnet of moment 2 A m² is cut into two equal halves perpendicular to its length. Find the moment of each half.

steps.en: Each half keeps the same pole strength.
m = pole strength × length becomes 2/2 = 1 A m².

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A bar magnet of moment 2 A m² is cut into two equal halves perpendicular to its length. Find the moment of each half.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A bar magnet of moment 2 A m squared is cut into two equal halves perpendicular to its length. Find the moment of each half.
Each half keeps the same pole strength.
Its length is halved.
m equals pole strength times length becomes 2 over 2 equals 1 A m squared.
So the answer is 1 A m squared each.
